name: Music Theory for Pianists
equipment: A piano or keyboard (optional for this lesson)
instructions: A "key" is a set of notes and chords that naturally sound good together -- it is why certain chord combinations feel so at home in a song.
The white-key-only C major scale corresponds to the "key of C," the simplest key to start recognizing.
You do not need deep theory to enjoy playing, but understanding keys makes learning new songs and improvising far more intuitive.
Watch today's video for a beginner's guide to music theory.
